title: Verdict
description: A Morphogen verdict: whether a candidate change to a cell is better than its base, on evidence the changer could not reach. Read from Morphogen's hash-chained evidence log.

claim.description: the judge's sentence, e.g. 'cell: abc is better than def'

gate.description: who may act on it: merge (an agent may), review (a person decides), none

trust.description: measured (on the real system) or simulated (on a model of it)

metrics.description: per metric: gain, 95% interval, sign test p, base and candidate medians

reasons.description: what the judge checked: forbidden files, tests, interfaces, equivalence

seq.description: its place in the evidence log

hash.description: its hash in the evidence log's chain
